verdict.rationale: macOS Setup Assistant explicitly supports bringing an iPhone near a new Mac to auto-sign into Wi-Fi and Apple Account (macos-docs-14), and Migration Assistant enables quick transfer of data/settings from a prior Mac or PC (macos-docs-1, macos-docs-2), directly matching the switcher story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the proximity-based setup flow and details on scope (e.g., what settings/apps transfer automatically).
